identity.summary: Provide developers with foundational skills to use and implement GenAI features in App Studio.

brief.intended_learning_outcome: Explain GenAI fundamentals, concepts, configuration, and implementation in App Studio.

sources.title: Pega GenAI Overview
sources.activity_purpose: Understand how Pega GenAI integrates generative models with enterprise workflows and security controls.
sources.activity_instructions: Review the Pega GenAI architecture and note the key governance mechanisms that ensure enterprise data security.

sources.title: Generative AI in Pega
sources.activity_purpose: Acquire structured foundational concepts of generative AI capabilities across Pega Infinity.
sources.activity_instructions: Work through the introductory generative AI topics and document three key use cases for developer acceleration.

sources.title: Pega GenAI Autopilot
sources.activity_purpose: Learn how conversational Autopilot assists developers with case life cycles and view creation in App Studio.
sources.activity_instructions: Examine Autopilot capabilities in App Studio and record the steps required to generate a case type using conversational prompts.

sources.title: Pega GenAI Coach
sources.activity_purpose: Understand how runtime AI coaches provide context-aware guidance and summaries to case workers.
sources.activity_instructions: Study the GenAI Coach configuration model and list the system instructions needed to guide case processing.

sources.title: AI Designer Landing Page
sources.activity_purpose: Master the AI Designer landing page to test prompts, compare model responses, and configure connect rules.
sources.activity_instructions: Explore the AI Designer playground and note how temperature and prompt adjustments affect generative model output.

sources.title: Running GenAI Connect Rules in App Studio
sources.activity_purpose: Implement and execute custom GenAI Connect rules directly within App Studio workflows.
sources.activity_instructions: Follow the implementation steps to execute a GenAI Connect rule and verify its response against a test case.

sources.title: Pega GenAI Case Summaries
sources.activity_purpose: Configure automated case summarization to provide concise case histories for operators.
sources.activity_instructions: Enable generative case summaries on a case type and verify that key case timeline events are accurately condensed.

sources.title: Document Processing with Pega GenAI
sources.activity_purpose: Implement automated document data extraction and analysis in case processing using generative AI.
sources.activity_instructions: Configure a document processing step with Pega GenAI and test extraction accuracy against sample incoming documents.
